audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Ryze all seven rows while the prose (whys[1], whys[2], whys[4]) and the packet chart both say Maokai owns Levels 2-3 and Level 6 is even.
audit.why: Maokai has W (Twisted Advance, 14s at rank 1) plus Q online at 2-3 with Sap Magic sustain, before Ryze has mana items; at 6 Nature's Grasp is gank setup, not a duel win.
audit.corrected: Rows: Ryze / Maokai / Maokai / Ryze / Skill / Ryze / Ryze, proposed as matched full+content pairs.

audit.why: Spikes list Maokai's 2-3 melee window, level 6 R, Ryze's first AP/mana item, and full-build Ryze — all four present and accurate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere states the decisive kit rule: Rune Prison only ROOTS if Spell Flux is already on the target, otherwise it is a slow.
audit.why: Riot's W text: 'If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' That makes Ryze's lockdown conditional on landing E first, which is the whole timing of the matchup.
audit.corrected: Stated in tldr, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns with the real 11s W cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no concrete cooldown-sequencing numbers.
audit.why: Rune Prison is 11s at rank 1, Spell Flux 3.5s, Maokai W 14s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Real numbers added to tldr, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: Weather the poke — root him on the Rune Prison cooldown and grind him with saplings. Maokai wins the Rune Prison cooldown windows.
edits.after: Rune Prison only roots if Spell Flux (E) is on you — step up after his E, not before. W-root on its 11s cooldown and grind him with saplings.

edits.before: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Rune Prison roots only if Spell Flux (E) is on you, else it slows. Engage on its 11s cooldown.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison: matchup-defining — His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ryze Rune Prison (11s): roots only through Spell Flux — dodge the E and it is just a slow. Step up there. - Your W (14s): never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

notes: Chart rows 1,2 and 4 flipped as one atomic group with matched content pairs; they now agree with packet.levelChart and with the existing whys prose. Did not assert whether Maokai's saplings body-block Overload (first-enemy-struck projectile) — unverified.
